# 分析対象外のデータの除外
```{r}
library(dplyr)

# --- Step 1: IMCチェック ---
mydata <- row_data %>%
  filter(rowSums(across(starts_with("IMC"), ~ . == 1), na.rm = TRUE) == 0)
message("Step 1 (IMC除外後) の行数: ", nrow(mydata))

# --- Step 2: 質問回答の質 ---
mydata <- mydata %>%
  filter(similar_question != 1, # 類似した調査に参加したか？という質問に「はい」と答えたデータを除外
         answer_seriously != 2) # 真剣に回答してくれたか？という質問に「いいえ」と答えたデータを除外
message("Step 2 (質による除外後) の行数: ", nrow(mydata))

# --- Step 3: 数値変換とNA ---
mydata <- mydata %>%
  mutate(Duration = as.numeric(Duration.inseconds.)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Duration))
message("Step 3 (Duration数値化後) の行数: ", nrow(mydata))

# --- Step 4: 外れ値除外 ---
mydata <- mydata %>%
  filter(
    Duration >= (mean(Duration, na.rm = TRUE) - 2 * sd(Duration, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Duration <= (mean(Duration, na.rm = TRUE) + 2 * sd(Duration, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
message("Step 4 (最終結果) の行数: ", nrow(mydata))
```

# 課題のメモ

- 戦略測定課題 戦略_1\~13
  - 反例なし 戦略_1, 戦略_4, 戦略_7
  - 90% 戦略_2, 戦略_5, 戦略_8, 戦略_10, 戦略_12
  - 50% 戦略_3, 戦略_6, 戦略_9, 戦略_11, 戦略_13
- 陰謀論信念GCBS
  - GCBS_1 \~ 15
- 疑似科学信念PBS
  - PBS_1 \~ 19
- CRT
  - 問題自体 CRT_1 \~ 8
  - 初見かの確認 初見か_1 \~ 8
- 科学的推論SRS
  - SRS_1 \~ 12
- 二分法的思考尺度 
  - DTI_1 \~ 15
- 開放的思考尺度
  - AOT AOT_1\~ 7

```{r}
strategy_Q_R90 <- c("戦略_2", "戦略_5", "戦略_8", "戦略_10", "戦略_12")
strategy_Q_R50 <- c("戦略_3", "戦略_6", "戦略_9", "戦略_11", "戦略_13")
strategy_Q_R100 <- c("戦略_1", "戦略_4", "戦略_7")
GCBS_Q <- paste0("GCBS_", 1:15)
PBS_Q <- paste0("PBS_", 1:19)
CRT_Q <- paste0("CRT_", 1:8)
CRT_seen <- paste0("初見か_", 1:8)
SRS_Q <- paste0("SRS_", 1:12)
DTI_Q <- paste0("DTI_", 1:15)
DTI_Q_preference <- paste0("DTI_", c(1,4,7,10,13))
DTI_Q_belief <- paste0("DTI_", c(2,5,8,11,14))
DTI_Q_profit_and_loss <- paste0("DTI_", c(3,6,9,12,15))
AOT_Q <-  paste0("AOT_", 1:7)
```

# 推論戦略ごとに分ける
```{r}
#それぞれの受容されなかった回数
mydata <- mydata %>%
  mutate(
    R90 = rowSums(across(all_of(strategy_Q_R90)) == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    R50 = rowSums(across(all_of(strategy_Q_R50)) == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    R100 = rowSums(across(all_of(strategy_Q_R100)) == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    R50_R90 = R50 - R90
  )

# 反例：CEX
# 統計：SS
# 反例と統計の中間：Inter
# その他：Other
mydata <- mydata %>%
  mutate(
    strategy_type = case_when(
      R50 > R90 + 1       ~ "SS",
      R90 + R50 == 10     ~ "CEX",
      R90 == 4            ~ "Inter",
      TRUE                ~ "Other"
    )
  )
mydata %>% count(strategy_type)

```
# 陰謀論信念・疑似科学信念
```{r}
mydata <- mydata %>%
  mutate(
    GCBS_total_score = rowSums(select(., all_of(GCBS_Q))),
    
    # 7問目を逆転処理（5件法：1〜5点）
    PBS_7_rev = (5 + 1) - PBS_7,
    
    # 合計点の算出
    # PBS_7の代わりに逆転処理済みの PBS_7_rev を含める
    PBS_total_score = rowSums(across(c(all_of(setdiff(PBS_Q, "PBS_7")), "PBS_7_rev")), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
```

# CRT
```{r}
#得点
crt_data <- mydata %>%
  mutate(
    # 正誤判定を行い得点を計算
    crtscore_1 = ifelse(`CRT_1` == "15", 1, 0),
    crtscore_2 = ifelse(`CRT_2` == "72", 1, 0),
    crtscore_3 = ifelse(`CRT_3` == "11", 1, 0),
    crtscore_4 = ifelse(`CRT_4` == "125", 1, 0),
    crtscore_5 = ifelse(`CRT_5` == "29", 1, 0),
    crtscore_6 = ifelse(`CRT_6` == "30", 1, 0),
    crtscore_7 = ifelse(`CRT_7` == "4", 1, 0),
    crtscore_8 = ifelse(`CRT_8` == "15", 1, 0),
  )

crt_data <- crt_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # 1. 初見の問題数（分母）をカウント (初見フラグが 2 のもの)
    CRT_attempted_count = sum(c_across(paste0("初見か_", 1:8)) == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # 2. 初見かつ正解した数（分子）をカウント
    CRT_correct_count = sum(map_dbl(1:8, function(i) {
      ans_val  <- get(paste0("crtscore_", i))
      seen_val <- get(paste0("初見か_", i))
      if (!is.na(ans_val) && !is.na(seen_val) && seen_val == 2 && ans_val == 1) 1 else 0
    })),
    
    # 3. 正答率を算出（0除算を防ぐため分母が0より大きい場合のみ計算）
    CRT_accuracy_rate = ifelse(CRT_attempted_count > 0, 
                               CRT_correct_count / CRT_attempted_count, 
                               NA)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

summary(crt_data$CRT_accuracy_rate)

mydata$CRT_accuracy_rate <- crt_data$CRT_accuracy_rate

mean(crt_data$CRT_correct_count, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# 正解キーの作成（1, 2, 1, 2... の並び）
srs_keys <- c(1, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2)

srs_data <- mydata %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # SRS_1~12 の値と正解キーを比較して合計
    SRS_total_score = sum(c_across(paste0("SRS_", 1:12)) == srs_keys, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

mydata$SRS_total_score <- srs_data$SRS_total_score
```

```{r}
mydata <- mydata %>%
```

```{r}
analysis_data <- mydata %>%
  select("ID", "R90", "R50", "R100", "R50_R90", "strategy_type", "GCBS_total_score", "PBS_total_score", "CRT_accuracy_rate", "SRS_total_score", "DTI_total_score", "DTI_preference_score", "DTI_belief_score", "DTI_profit_and_loss_score", "AOT_score")

analysis_data$strategy_type <- as.factor(analysis_data$strategy_type)

standardized_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(across(
    # 「数値型」かつ「Idではない」列を選択
    .cols = where(is.numeric) & !all_of("ID"), 
    .fns = ~ as.numeric(scale(.))
  ))
```

```{r}
analysis_data %>%
  group_by(strategy_type) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c("GCBS_total_score", "PBS_total_score", "CRT_accuracy_rate", "SRS_total_score", "DTI_total_score", "DTI_preference_score", "DTI_belief_score", "DTI_profit_and_loss_score", "AOT_score"),
      list(
```

```{r}
                       data = standardized_data)
```

##　多項ロジスティック回帰 
### brm
```{r}
model <- brm(
  strategy_type ~ GCBS_total_score + PBS_total_score + CRT_accuracy_rate + SRS_total_score +  DTI_preference_score + DTI_belief_score + DTI_profit_and_loss_score +  AOT_score,
  data = standardized_data,
  family = categorical(link = "logit"),
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4
)

summary(model)
```

### multinom関数を用いた多項ロジスティック回帰

```{r}
#DTIをまとめたモデル
model_total <- multinom(strategy_type ~ GCBS_total_score + PBS_total_score + CRT_accuracy_rate + SRS_total_score + DTI_total_score +  AOT_score,
                  data = standardized_data)

#DTIを下位尺度で分けたモデル
model_sub <- multinom(strategy_type ~ GCBS_total_score + PBS_total_score + CRT_accuracy_rate + SRS_total_score + DTI_preference_score + DTI_belief_score + DTI_profit_and_loss_score +  AOT_score,
                  data = standardized_data)
summary(model_total)
summary(model_sub)
```

```{r}
logLik(model_total)
logLik(model_sub)
```

```{r}
#P値の導出
z <- summary(model_total)$coefficients/summary(model_total)$standard.errors
p <- 2*(1 - pnorm(abs(z)))
p
```

```{r}

# 5. オッズ比の計算
odds_ratios <- exp(coef(model_sub))
odds_ratios

# 6. z値とp値の計算
z_values <- summary(model_sub)$coefficients / summary(model_sub)$standard.errors
p_values <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_values)))
p_values

# 7. 各カテゴリの予測確率
pred_prob <- predict(model_sub, newdata = standardized_data, type = "probs")
prob_df <- cbind(standardized_data, pred_prob)
head(prob_df)

# 8. 可視化用データ整形
prob_long <- prob_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("SS", "CEX", "Inter", "Other"),  # pred_prob 内の列すべてを縦長に
    names_to = "Predicted_Type",
    values_to = "Probability"
  )

# 9. 予測確率の箱ひげ図
ggplot(prob_long, aes(x = Predicted_Type, y = Probability, fill = strategy_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal() +
  ylab("Predicted Probability") +
  xlab("Predicted Strategy Type") +
  ggtitle("Predicted Probabilities by Actual Strategy Type")
```

# パス解析（ベースモデル）
```{r}
library(lavaan)
library(semPlot)
library(dplyr)

model_strategy_mediation <- '
  CRT_accuracy_rate ~~ AOT_score
  GCBS_total_score ~~ PBS_total_score
  SRS_total_score ~ CRT_accuracy_rate + AOT_score + DTI_total_score
  R50_R90 ~ CRT_accuracy_rate + AOT_score + DTI_total_score
  GCBS_total_score ~ CRT_accuracy_rate + AOT_score + DTI_total_score + SRS_total_score + R50_R90
  PBS_total_score ~ CRT_accuracy_rate + AOT_score + DTI_total_score + SRS_total_score + R50_R90
'

# 適合
fit_mediation <- sem(model_strategy_mediation, 
                     data = standardized_data, 
                     estimator = "MLR") # ダミー変数を含むのでMLRが安定します

# 確認
summary(fit_mediation, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)

lavaanPlot(model = fit_mediation, 
           coefs = TRUE, 
           stand = TRUE, 
           sig = .05, 
           stars = "regress",
           graph_options = list(rankdir = "LR"))
```

```{r}
fitMeasures(fit_mediation, c("srmr", "cfi", "rmsea", "agfi", "ecvi"))
```

```{r}
modificationindices(fit_mediation)
```

# パス解析（改良モデル）SRS→R50-R90の階層モデル
```{r}
library(lavaan)
library(semPlot)
library(dplyr)

model_Layer <- '
  CRT_accuracy_rate ~~ AOT_score
  AOT_score ~~ DTI_total_score
  CRT_accuracy_rate ~~ DTI_total_score

  R50_R90 ~ CRT_accuracy_rate + AOT_score + DTI_total_score
  SRS_total_score ~ CRT_accuracy_rate + AOT_score + DTI_total_score + R50_R90

  GCBS_total_score ~ SRS_total_score + DTI_total_score
  PBS_total_score ~ SRS_total_score + DTI_total_score

  GCBS_total_score ~~ PBS_total_score
'

# 適合
fit_model_Layer <- sem(model_Layer, 
                     data = standardized_data, 
                     estimator = "MLR") # ダミー変数を含むのでMLRが安定します

# 確認
summary(fit_model_Layer, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)

lavaanPlot(model = fit_model_Layer, 
           coefs = TRUE, 
           stand = TRUE, 
           sig = .05, 
           stars = "regress",
           graph_options = list(rankdir = "LR"))

summary(fit_model_Layer, standardized = TRUE, fit.measure = TRUE)
```

```{r}
fitMeasures(fit_model_Layer, c("srmr", "cfi", "rmsea", "agfi", "ecvi"))
```

```{r}
modificationindices(fit_model_Layer)
```
# パス解析（改良モデル）SRS・R50-R90の並列モデル
```{r}
library(lavaan)
library(semPlot)
library(dplyr)

model_parallel <- '
  CRT_accuracy_rate ~~ AOT_score
  AOT_score ~~ DTI_total_score
  CRT_accuracy_rate ~~ DTI_total_score
  
  R50_R90 ~ CRT_accuracy_rate + AOT_score + DTI_total_score
  SRS_total_score ~ CRT_accuracy_rate + AOT_score + DTI_total_score
  
  R50_R90 ~~ SRS_total_score
  
  GCBS_total_score ~ SRS_total_score + DTI_total_score + R50_R90
  PBS_total_score ~ SRS_total_score + DTI_total_score + R50_R90
  
  GCBS_total_score ~~ PBS_total_score

'

# 適合
fit_model_parallel <- sem(model_parallel, 
                     data = standardized_data, 
                     estimator = "MLR") # ダミー変数を含むのでMLRが安定します

# 確認
summary(fit_model_parallel, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)

lavaanPlot(model = fit_model_parallel, 
           coefs = TRUE, 
           stand = TRUE, 
           sig = .05, 
           stars = "regress",
           graph_options = list(rankdir = "LR"))

summary(fit_model_parallel, standardized = TRUE, fit.measure = TRUE)
```

```{r}
fitMeasures(fit_model_parallel, c("srmr", "cfi", "rmsea", "agfi", "ecvi"))
```
